rows.note: 切 is the all-purpose everyday verb for cutting meat into serving pieces.

example.english: I’ll carve the chicken into serving pieces first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 cit3 di1 gai1 juk6 sin1

rows.note: Use 刻 for cutting letters, names, or simple designs into a surface rather than shaping a whole sculpture.

example.english: I’ll carve your name into the wooden sign.
example.traditional: 我喺木牌上刻低你個名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 muk6 paai4 soeng6 hak1 dai1 nei5 go3 meng2

rows.note: Use 雕刻 for producing a sculpted or ornamental work by cutting the material.

example.english: The craftsman had to carve this wooden sculpture by hand.
example.traditional: 呢件木雕係師傅親手雕刻嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 muk6 diu1 hai6 si1 fu6 can1 sau2 diu1 hak1 ge3
